# 02 — Harness root (`harness/`)

**Purpose.** The directory every `project.yaml` path is relative to. This file fixes the
layout of the harness root: which files are the owner's, which are generated, which are
living, and the exact shape of the archive folders. It contains no logic.

**Owns.** The layout. The content of generated files is owned by the component that
generates them (named per file below).

**Depends on.** `project.yaml` for `livingSourcePaths`, `lockedProsePath`,
`archivesPath`, `roundPaths`, `subAgentsFile`. Everything below marked *from config*
is read from those keys at run time, never hard-coded (the code holds only the key
names).

**Depended on by.** Every component; they address these paths through `paths.py` (04).

## Layout

```
harness/
├── AGENTS.md              OWNER. Sections `## ADVICE.`, `## INVARIANTS.`,
│                          `## DEFINED AND UNDEFINED JUDGMENT CALLS`; any `##` section is
│                          addressable as {{ agents.<HEADING> }} (04 agentsmd).
├── project.yaml           OWNER. Read by config.py (04). Whole settings surface with subAgents.yaml.
├── subAgents.yaml         OWNER. Named by project.yaml: subAgentsFile. Roster (06 agentdefs, 09 pricing).
├── locked_prose/          OWNER. *from config* lockedProsePath. <NAME>.txt files (05 prose).
├── INDEX.md               GENERATED by index.py (11); committed; test-checked.
├── local.yaml             GENERATED by localyaml.py (04); gitignored; derived facts only.
├── OWNER.log              GENERATED by hooks.py (06); gitignored; JSONL, one owner prompt per line.
├── pyproject.toml         Hand-written, see below.
├── .claude/settings.json  Hand-written, see below.
├── .claude/agents/        GENERATED by agentdefs.py (06); committed; test-checked.
├── src/                   LIVING (*from config*). run.py + shackles/ package (03–11).
├── docs/                  LIVING. PROCESS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, TODO.md, CLARIFICATIONS.md (12).
├── tests/                 LIVING. The suite (13), probes (14).
└── archives/              *from config* archivesPath.
    ├── spec-baseline/
    │   ├── MANIFEST.json      {"files": {"<path rel. to spec.yaml>": {"sha256": "...", "bytes": n}}, "accepted_at": iso}
    │   └── files/<path>       byte-exact snapshot of each accepted spec file
    └── rounds/NNNN/           *from config* roundPaths.folder with NNNN substituted
        ├── PLAN.json                 roundPaths.artifacts.plan         (CHAT-TO-PLAN, driver)
        ├── AGENTS-PLAN.json          .agentsPlan                       (PLAN-AGENTS)
        ├── SPEC.json                 .spec                             (PLAN-TO-SPEC)
        ├── SPEC.md                   .specProse                        (PLAN-TO-SPEC)
        ├── SUITE.json                .suite                            (TESTS-TO-SUITE)
        ├── POSTMORTEM.md             .postmortem                       (POSTMORTEM)
        ├── STATE.json                roundPaths.runner.state           (runner; the only runner state)
        ├── HISTORY.md                .history                          (runner; append-only)
        ├── OWNER.log                 .ownerLog                         (runner; this round's slice, JSONL)
        ├── PROMPTS/STEP-n.txt        roundPaths.attempts.prompts       (runner; rendered prompt)
        ├── RESULTS/STEP-n.json       .results                          (driver; the final message verbatim)
        ├── FINDINGS/STEP-n.json      .findings                         (runner; the normalized gate verdict)
        ├── tests-archive/…           roundPaths.testsArchive           (runner moves; keeps path relative to testPaths root)
        ├── DEFINED_JUDGMENT_CALLS.md roundPaths.judgmentCalls.defined  (agents via `run.py jc`; gates via runner)
        └── UNDEFINED_JUDGMENT_CALLS.md .undefined
```

The round folder is the **only** place agents may write outside their step's declared
paths. The runner may add nothing to the round folder beyond the entries above; new
runner state goes into `STATE.json` (JC-26).

## Hand-written files at the harness root

### `pyproject.toml`
```
[project] name = "shackles-harness", version = "0", requires-python = ">=3.11",
          dependencies = ["pyyaml>=6", "pytest>=8"]
[tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths = ["tests"], addopts = "-q --ignore=tests/probes"
[tool.setuptools] packages = ["shackles"], package-dir = {"" = "src"}
```
No build step is needed to run; `python3 src/run.py` works from a clone once the two
dependencies are installed (JC-03).

### `.claude/settings.json`
```
{"hooks": {
   "UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command",
        "command": "python3 \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/src/run.py hook prompt"}]}],
   "SessionStart":     [{"hooks": [{"type": "command",
        "command": "python3 \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/src/run.py hook session-start"}]}]}}
```
The hook commands are thin (06 `hooks.py`): `prompt` appends the submitted prompt to
`OWNER.log`; `session-start` regenerates `local.yaml`, creates `OWNER.log` if absent
with a session marker line, and prints a warning line when `.claude/agents/` is stale
so the driver tells the owner to run `setup` and restart (JC-10). The hook event names and `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` are platform details (JC-54).

### `.claude/agents/`
Two files per rung in `subAgents.yaml`: `shackles-<rung>-work.md` and
`shackles-<rung>-gate.md`. Shape in 15-schemas §Agent definition. Regenerated by
`run.py setup`; `start` refuses when their stamp does not match the roster hash.

## Invariants
- Only `OWNER.log`, `local.yaml`, `.worktrees/` are uncommitted; everything else in the
  harness root is tracked.
- `INDEX.md` and `.claude/agents/*` are generated but committed; a test regenerates them
  into memory and asserts equality with the committed bytes.
- Agents never write to `AGENTS.md`, `project.yaml`, `subAgents.yaml`, `locked_prose/`;
  the mechanical checks (10) revert any such change in a worktree.

## Covered by
- `tests/test_paths.py` (layout resolution from config), `tests/test_index.py`,
  `tests/test_agents_defs.py::test_committed_defs_current`,
  `tests/test_repo_scaffold.py::test_settings_json_hooks`.
